steps.player: Rashiliyia? Who is she?

steps.speaker: Mosol Rei
steps.text: Rashiliyia is the Queen of the dead. She has returned and has brought a plague of undead with her. They now occupy our village and we have them trapped. I warn people like yourself to stay away.

options.text: What can we do?

steps.player: What can we do?

steps.speaker: Mosol Rei
steps.text: And the undead are even stronger beyond the gates. My guess is that it has something to do with the Legend of Rashiliyia.

steps.speaker: Mosol Rei
steps.text: But you would need to talk to the Shaman in Tai Bwo Wannai village to get more details about that. I really have to go now and fight these undead.

starting-out-using-the-wampum-belt-on-tr.text: Hello Bwana, this message from Mosol Rei bears bad news... Yes, things do look very bad indeed.

options.text: What do you know about Rashiliyia?

steps.player: What do you know about Rashiliyia?

steps.speaker: Trufitus
steps.text: Hmmm, it's been a long time since I heard that name. Rashiliyia is the Queen of the Undead. And a more fearsome enemy you will be unlikely to find.

steps.speaker: Trufitus
steps.text: I fear that you bring me news that she has returned to plague us once again? Alas I know of no weakness that she has.

options.text: So there is nothing we can do?

steps.player: So there is nothing we can do?

steps.speaker: Trufitus
steps.text: Not that I can think of.

options.text: Oh, ok!

steps.text: Well, I hope you will excuse me, but I need to get back to my studies.

options.text: Should I start to evacuate the Island?

steps.speaker: Trufitus
steps.text: Yes, that may be a good idea. Many people could die! If only there was a way to defeat her!

options.text: Mosol Rei said something about a legend?

steps.player: Mosol Rei said something about a legend?

steps.speaker: Trufitus
steps.text: Ah, yes, there is a legend, but it is lost in the midst of antiquity...

steps.speaker: Trufitus
steps.text: The last place to hold any details regarding this mystery was in the temple of Ah Za Rhoon....and that has long since vanished... it crumbled into dust...

options.text: Why was it called Ah Za Rhoon?

steps.player: Why was it called Ah Za Rhoon?

steps.speaker: Trufitus
steps.text: It is from an ancient language. The direct translation is... 'Magnificence floating on water'. But my research makes me believe that the temple was built on land.

steps.speaker: Trufitus
steps.text: And most likely between large bodies of water, for example large lakes. However, many people have searched for the temple, and have failed. I would hate to see you waste your time on a pointless search like that.

options.text: Thanks for the information!

steps.player: Thanks for the information!

steps.text: Trufitus looks at you blankly...

steps.speaker: Trufitus

options.text: Tell me more.

steps.player: Tell me more.
